director.name: Sudhir Shrestha, Ph.D.
director.title: PI and Director, Intelligent Systems Lab
director.department: Department of Engineering and Computer Science
bio: Dr. Shrestha builds intelligent systems for the real world, with a focus on robots that learn new skills from human demonstration and simulation.

He is a Professor in the Department of Engineering and Computer Science at Sonoma State University, where he founded the Intelligent Systems Lab in 2017 and serves as its director. His research centers on robot learning and manipulation, including sim-to-real transfer, imitation learning, and vision-language-action models, with related work in intelligent sensing and embedded AI.
He created SSU's robotics and computer vision curriculum and developed the Engineering Robotics and AI Lab, which opened in Fall 2026. Through ISL, he has mentored more than 100 students.

He holds seven U.S. patents, has authored more than 35 peer-reviewed publications, and is an IEEE Senior Member. His work has been funded by NSF and CSU grants. He earned his Ph.D. at Louisiana Tech University, then completed postdoctoral training and served on the research faculty at Purdue University in Indianapolis before joining SSU.
Students, researchers, and industry partners interested in collaborations are welcome to get in touch.
